item.title: Email Alerts – How to Change my Email Address
item.description: Are you a template-bmjj subscriber? If your online record contains the same email address where you receive your template-bmjj alerts, you may sign in and update your email address in your online record. After you make this change, your template-bmjj alerts will be sent to your new address.You may also update the email address of your template-bmjj and other HighWire-hosted journal email alerts from the HighWire site. item.title: Comment on: Misselwitz B, Butter M, Verbeke K, Fox MR. Update on lactose malabsorption and intolerance: pathogenesis, diagnosis and clinical management. Gut. 2019;68:2080–2091. doi:10.1136/gutjnl-2019-318404
item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody We consider the publication by Misselwitz et al. on “Update on lactose malabsorption and intolerance: pathogenesis, diagnosis and clinical management,” published in Gut, to provide a thorough overview of this important topic.
